name: vital-focused
description: FOCUSED coaching (Frame, Options, Criteria, Unknowns, Score, Examine, Decide). Runs offline with a local session file and pack tools for worksheets, score with ±10 robustness, and brief. Person decides at every step; skills never name a winner. Optional vdec_ key enables Decision cloud sync or usage only. Optional vont_ / vvfy_ for Navigator sealed scores and Verify claim checks. Human oversight required. Product of Crossroads Catalyst GmbH (Vital Expert).

decision_key.title: VITAL Decision Companion key (optional)
decision_key.description: Optional vdec_ key for cloud sync, export, or usage only. Not required for FOCUSED coaching, local score, or brief.

navigator_key.title: VITAL Ontology Navigator key (optional)
navigator_key.description: Optional vont_ key for sealed decide_* / methods_* handoffs. Not required for local score.

verify_key.title: VITAL Verify key (optional)
verify_key.description: Optional vvfy_ key for qualify_source / check_claim handoffs.
